title: SafeStep Enrollment and Tier Placement Rules
content:
# Enrollment and Tier Placement — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

## 1. Credit standing at enrollment

A program is enrolled only for a customer whose Commercial Credit Account status is active.

The credit account status is taken from the company's own Commercial Credit Account record for the same customer, as it stands before the enrollment. A customer whose Commercial Credit Account has any other status (for example on hold, in collections or closed) is not enrolled.

## 2. Tier placement

The tier is the one requested when the roster meets its minimum participants, otherwise the highest tier met.

Each SafeStep tier has a minimum number of participants:

| Tier (low to high) | Minimum participants on the roster |
|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 10 |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 25 |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 50 |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 100 |
| SafeStep Premier | 250 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 750 |

A roster meets a tier's minimum when it has at least that many participants.

| Roster meets the requested tier's minimum? | Tier placed |
|---|---|
| Yes | The requested tier |
| No | The highest tier whose minimum the roster meets |

### Placement examples (hypothetical rosters)

- Requested SafeStep Premier, roster of 180: the roster does not meet 250; the highest tier met is SafeStep Mobile Fitting (100), which is placed.
- Requested SafeStep Voucher Plus, roster of 300: the roster meets 25, so SafeStep Voucher Plus is placed, although higher tiers are also met.
- Requested SafeStep Mobile Fitting, roster of exactly 100: the roster meets the minimum, so SafeStep Mobile Fitting is placed.

## 3. Go-live and the first allowance year

The first allowance year starts on go-live under the tier's allowance year basis (a calendar-year program's first year ends on December 31 of the go-live year). A calendar-year program that goes live on any date therefore has a first allowance year running from go-live to December 31 of that year.

At go-live the program moves from enrolled to active: the participant roster is loaded, allowances are granted and vouchers go live.
